attributes.name: தீவிர மழைவீழ்ச்சி நாட்களில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்
attributes.description:
### கண்ணோட்டம்  
  
1960-1990 ஆம் ஆண்டின் அடிப்படை காலத்துடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது, 2000 மற்றும் 2080 க்கு இடையில் பத்து வருட இடைவெளியில் தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவின் வருடாந்திர சராசரி நாட்களில் ஏற்பட்ட மாற்றத்தை தீவிர மழைவீழ்ச்சி தினங்களின் தரவுத்தொகுப்பில் கணிக்கப்பட்ட மாற்றம் காட்டுகிறது. ஒரு தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவு நாள் என்பது அடிப்படை காலத்துடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது 99 வது சதவீத மழைப்பொழிவை விட அதிகமாக இருக்கும் ஒரு நாள் என்று வரையறுக்கப்படுகிறது. ஒவ்வொரு பத்து ஆண்டு இடைவெளியிலும் காட்டப்படும் தரவு 31 ஆண்டு சராசரியைக் குறிக்கிறது, இது குறிக்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டை மையமாகக் கொண்டது. உதாரணமாக, 2000 ஆம் ஆண்டில் தீவிர மழைவீழ்ச்சி நாட்களின் எண்ணிக்கை உண்மையில் 1985 மற்றும் 2015 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு இடையில் தீவிர மழைவீழ்ச்சி நாட்களின் வருடாந்திர எண்ணிக்கையின் சராசரியாகும். காலநிலை மாற்றம் (ஐபிசிசியின்) பிரதிநிதித்துவ செறிவு பாதைகள் (ஆர்.சி.பி) 8.5 இன் அரசாங்கங்களுக்கிடையிலான குழுவால் தீர்மானிக்கப்படும் எதிர்கால பசுமை இல்ல வாயு உமிழ்வு விகிதங்களை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டது மழைவீழ்ச்சி கணிப்புகள். ஆர்சிபி 8.5 என்பது 21 ஆம் நூற்றாண்டுக்குள் கிரீன்ஹவுஸ் வாயு உமிழ்வு விகிதங்களில் எந்த குறைவும் இல்லாத ஒரு கற்பனையான காட்சியாகும். தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவில் ஏற்படும் மாற்றம், திட்டமிடப்பட்ட தசாப்தத்தின் போது தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவின் வருடாந்திர சராசரி நாட்கள் மற்றும் அடிப்படை கால இடைவெளி ஆகியவற்றுக்கு இடையிலான பெருக்கல் வேறுபாடு என காட்டப்படுகிறது. 1 ஐ விட அதிகமான மதிப்புகள் தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவு அதிகரித்து வருவதைக் குறிக்கின்றன, அதே நேரத்தில் ஒன்றுக்கும் குறைவான மதிப்புகள் எண்ணிக்கை குறைந்து வருவதைக் குறிக்கின்றன. தரவு 0.25° இடஞ்சார்ந்த தெளிவுத்திறனில் வழங்கப்படுகிறது.
  
உலகளாவிய கிரீன்ஹவுஸ் வாயு செறிவு அதிகரிப்பு மற்றும் அதன் விளைவாக காலநிலை மாற்றம் ஆகியவை, விவசாயம், உள்கட்டமைப்பு, பேரழிவு மேலாண்மை மற்றும் மனித மோதலை பாதிக்கும் கிரகத்துடனான நமது உறவை அடிப்படையாக மாற்றுகின்றன. இந்த மாற்றங்களை எதிர்பார்க்கவும், தகவமைத்துக் கொள்ளவும், எக்ஸ்ட்ரீம் வீழ்படிவு நாட்களில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம் தரவுத்தொகுப்பு வரவிருக்கும் தசாப்தங்களில் தீவிர மழைவீழ்ச்சி முறைகள் எவ்வாறு மாறக்கூடும் என்பது குறித்த கணிப்புகளை வழங்குகிறது. பொதுவாக, தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவு நிகழ்வுகள் உலகளவில் அடிக்கடி நிகழும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது. 
  
இந்த தரவுத்தொகுப்பை Vizzuality மற்றும் உலக வளங்கள் நிறுவனம் மூலம் தேசிய ஏரோநாட்டிக்ஸ் மற்றும் விண்வெளி நிர்வாகம் (நாசா) எர்த் எக்ஸ்சேஞ்ச் குளோபல் டெய்லி டவுன்ஸ்கேல்ட் ப்ரொஜெக்ஷன்ஸ் (நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி) பயன்படுத்தி செயலாக்கியுள்ளது. நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி தரவுத்தொகுப்பு, உள்ளூர் முதல் பிராந்திய அளவிலான காலநிலை மாற்ற தாக்கங்கள் குறித்த ஆய்வுகளை நடத்துவதில் அறிவியல் சமூகத்திற்கு உதவுவதையும், தனிப்பட்ட நகரங்கள், நகரங்கள் மற்றும் நீர்ப்பிடிப்புப் பகுதிகளின் இடஞ்சார்ந்த அளவில் எதிர்கால உலகளாவிய காலநிலை வடிவங்கள் குறித்த பொது புரிதலை மேம்படுத்துவதையும் நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. இந்த தரவுத்தொகுப்பின் முந்தைய பதிப்பு செயலாக்கப்பட்டு தயாரிக்கப்பட்டது [பின்னடைவு மற்றும் தயார்நிலைக்கான கூட்டாண்மை (பி.ஆர்.இ.பி)] (https://prepdata.org/), காலநிலை தரவுகளுக்கான அணுகலை மேம்படுத்துவதன் மூலம் காலநிலை மாற்றத்திற்கு பின்னடைவைக் கட்டியெழுப்புவதற்கான பி.ஆர்.இ.பி.யின் பணியில் உதவியது.  
  
### முறைமை  
  
எக்ஸ்ட்ரீம் வீழ்படிவு நாட்கள் தரவுத்தளத்தில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம் நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி.யிலிருந்து மழை தரவுகளுடன் உருவாக்கப்பட்டது. நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி தரவுத் தொகுப்புகள் உலகளாவிய சுழற்சி மாதிரி (ஜி.சி.எம்) சோதனைகளிலிருந்து பெறப்பட்டன, அவை [காலநிலை மாற்றத்திற்கான அரசாங்கங்களுக்கு இடையிலான குழு (ஐபிசிசி) ஐந்தாவது மதிப்பீட்டு அறிக்கை (ஏஆர்5)] (https://www.ipcc.ch/site/assets/uploads/2018/05/SYR_AR5_FINAL_full_wcover.pdf). இணைந்த மாதிரி இண்டர்கம்பரிசன் திட்டம் கட்டம் 5 (சிஎம்ஐபி5) என அழைக்கப்படும் இந்த சோதனைகள், கிரீன்ஹவுஸ் வாயு செறிவுகளின் பல்வேறு நிலைகளில் காலநிலையை உருவகப்படுத்த வடிவமைக்கப்பட்ட காலநிலை மாதிரிகளின் முடிவுகளை உள்ளடக்கியது.  

சி.எம்.ஐ.பி 5 தரவு மாதிரிகள் (45), காலநிலை காட்சிகள் (4), ஆண்டுகள் (150+), மற்றும் மாறிகள் (20-40) ஆகியவற்றை உள்ளடக்கியது. அதன் கரடுமுரடான தீர்மானத்தில் (1-4° ) கூட இது பில்லியன் கணக்கான அடுக்குகளில் விளைகிறது. டவுன்ஸ்கேலிங் மூலம், நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி அவர்கள் தேவைப்படும் தரவை மட்டுமே பிரித்தெடுக்கிறது மற்றும் [ஷெஃபீல்ட் மற்றும் பலர். (2006)] (https://journals.ametsoc.org/jcli/article/19/13/3088/30860/Development-இன்-ஒரு-50-ஆண்டு-உயர்-தெளிவுத்திறன்-உலகளாவிய) தரவுத்தொகுப்பை வரலாற்றுக் குறிப்புகளாகப் பயன்படுத்தி, தரவின் ஒட்டுமொத்த அளவையும் குறைக்கிறது.  

ஒவ்வொரு ஆண்டும் வருடாந்திர சராசரி தீவிர மழை நாட்கள், காலநிலை மாதிரி, மற்றும் சூழ்நிலை ஆகியவை ஒரு பிக்சல் அடிப்படையில் நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி தரவைப் பயன்படுத்தி கணக்கிடப்பட்டன. இது ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட வருடத்திற்கான தினசரி மழைவீழ்ச்சி மதிப்புகளை பிரித்தெடுப்பதன் மூலமும், அடிப்படை காலத்தில் 99 வது சதவீத மழைப்பொழிவை விட மழைப்பொழிவு அதிகமாக இருந்த நாட்களின் எண்ணிக்கையைத் தொகுப்பதன் மூலமும் செய்யப்பட்டது. ஆண்டு சராசரி தீவிர மழை நாட்கள் 1960-1990 அடிப்படை காலத்திற்கான 31 ஆண்டு சராசரி மற்றும் ஒன்பது காலங்கள் 2000 முதல் 2080 வரை ஒவ்வொரு தசாப்தத்தின் தொடக்கத்திலும் மையப்படுத்தப்பட்டன. பின்னர் ஒன்பது திட்டமிடப்பட்ட தசாப்தங்களில் ஒவ்வொன்றும் தீவிர மழைவீழ்ச்சியில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றத்தைக் கணக்கிட அடிப்படை சராசரியால் பிரிக்கப்பட்டன. 1 ஐ விட அதிகமான மதிப்புகள் தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவு அதிகரித்து வருவதைக் குறிக்கின்றன, அதே நேரத்தில் ஒன்றுக்கும் குறைவான மதிப்புகள் எண்ணிக்கை குறைந்து வருவதைக் குறிக்கின்றன.

ஒவ்வொரு பத்து ஆண்டு இடைவெளியிலும் காட்டப்படும் தரவு 31 ஆண்டு சராசரியைக் குறிக்கிறது, இது குறிக்கப்பட்ட ஆண்டை மையமாகக் கொண்டது. எடுத்துக்காட்டாக, 2000 ஆம் ஆண்டில் தீவிர மழை நாட்கள் உண்மையில் 1985 மற்றும் 2015 ஆண்டுகளுக்கு இடையில் வருடாந்திர தீவிர மழைவீழ்ச்சி நாட்களின் சராசரியாகும். 31 ஆண்டு சராசரிகள் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்டன, ஏனெனில் அவை வருடாந்திர மற்றும் தசாப்த மாறுபாட்டின் விளைவுகளைக் குறைத்து, நீண்ட கால காலநிலை சமிக்ஞையை முன்னிலைப்படுத்துகின்றன. உலக வானிலை அமைப்பின் நீண்டகால வழிகாட்டுதலுடன் ஒத்துப்போக அடிப்படை காலம் தேர்ந்தெடுக்கப்பட்டது.
  
### கூடுதல் தகவல்  
  
Resource Watch மேலும் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம் NEX-GDDP RCP 8.5 தரவு காட்டுகிறது [வருடாந்திர சராசரி வெப்பநிலையில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/4ca6826c-718d-457d-b4e2-e9277d7ed62c), [வருடாந்திர சராசரி குறைந்தபட்ச வெப்பநிலையில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/3d8e2e82-b33a-4898-90e5-6e4a1d007b82), [வருடாந்திர சராசரி அதிகபட்ச வெப்பநிலையில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/c4b12251-2d61-458f-4898-90e5-6e4a1d007b82), [வருடாந்திர சராசரி அதிகபட்ச வெப்பநிலையில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/c4b12251-2d61-458f-0007b82) வெப்பமாக்கும் டிகிரி நாட்களில் மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/1d2f4eae-10e1-4ea6-980c-501b34106de2), [கூலிங் டிகிரி நாட்களில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/6fa000b5-8d91-46c8-8502-07427bc5eafc), [உறைபனி இல்லாத பருவத்தில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/d3f512c0-fbb0-47d5-9ac9-a452574c8e58), [தீவிர வெப்ப நாட்களில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/3941bbba-181b-434a-84cdf55) ஒட்டுமொத்த மழைப்பொழிவில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/faf79d2c-5e54-4591-9d70-4bd1029c18e6), மற்றும் [உலர் எழுத்துப்பிழைகளில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/d0f46576-411d-48aa-8df8-d89a3792cdce).

Resource Watch தரவின் ஒரு துணைக்குழுவை மட்டுமே காட்டுகிறது. உமிழ்வு சூழ்நிலை RCP 4.5 க்கான கூடுதல் தரவு கிடைக்கிறது. அசல் NEX-GDDP தரவுத்தொகுப்பு மற்றும் கூடுதல் தகவலுக்கான அணுகலுக்கு, மேலும் அறிக இணைப்பைப் பார்க்கவும்.
  
### தரவை காட்சிப்படுத்தல்  
  
Resource Watch இல் காண்பிக்கப்படுவதற்கு முன்பு எங்கள் குழு இந்த தரவுத்தொகுப்பை மறுவடிவமைத்தது. [Github] (https://github.com/resource-வாட்ச்/தரவு-முன் செயலாக்கம்/மரம்/மாஸ்டர்/cli_050-059_066-075_nexgddp_and_loca) இல் உள்ள தரவை Resource Watch எவ்வாறு செயலாக்கியது என்பதற்கான ஆவணங்களைப் பார்க்கவும்.  
  
### பொறுப்புத்துறப்பு  
  
இந்த விளக்கப் பக்கத்தின் பகுதிகள் மூல மெட்டாடேட்டாவிலிருந்து எடுக்கப்பட்டன.

info.functions: தீவிர மழைப்பொழிவின் வருடாந்திர சராசரி நாட்களில் திட்டமிடப்பட்ட மாற்றம்
info.cautions:
- சில ஜி.சி.எம். மழைக்காலங்கள் போன்ற பிராந்திய காலநிலை வடிவங்களை மீண்டும் உருவாக்குவதில் மற்றவர்களை விட சிறப்பாக செயல்படுகிறது. குறிப்பிட்ட பயன்பாடுகளுக்கு, பிராந்திய செயல்திறன் அடிப்படையில் தனிப்பட்ட மாதிரிகளைத் தேர்ந்தெடுப்பது பொருத்தமானதாக இருக்கலாம்.
- இந்த குறிகாட்டிகளை உருவாக்கப் பயன்படுத்தப்படும் கீழ்நோக்கிய அணுகுமுறைகள், வெப்பநிலை மற்றும் மழைவீழ்ச்சியில் உள்ள ஒப்பீட்டு இடஞ்சார்ந்த வடிவங்கள் எதிர்கால காலநிலை மாற்றத்தின் கீழ் மாறாமல் இருக்கும் என்று இயல்பாகவே கருதுகின்றன. முக்கிய காற்று மற்றும் கடல் நீரோட்டங்கள் மெதுவாக அல்லது தலைகீழாக மாறுவது போன்ற உலகளாவிய வானிலை வடிவங்களில் வியத்தகு மாற்றங்கள் சாத்தியமாகும், ஆனால் இந்த குறிகாட்டிகளில் பிடிக்கப்படாது.
- கீழிறக்கத்திற்குப் பயன்படுத்தப்படும் வரலாற்றுத் தரவுகள் உலகெங்கிலும் தரத்தில் வேறுபடுகின்றன. குறிப்பாக, குறுகிய பதிவுகள் அல்லது வானிலை அவதானிப்புகளின் குறைவான கவரேஜ் கொண்ட பகுதிகள் துல்லியத்தைக் குறைத்திருக்கலாம்.
- ஜி.சி.எம் சுயாதீன ஆராய்ச்சிக் குழுக்களால் உருவாக்கப்பட்டு, வெவ்வேறு அனுமானங்கள் மற்றும் வழிமுறைகளை உள்ளடக்கியிருப்பதால், அவை கணிசமான அளவிலான எதிர்காலங்களை உள்ளடக்கியிருக்கலாம். நாங்கள் குறைந்த மற்றும் உயர் மதிப்பீடுகளை வழங்குகிறோம், இதனால் பயனர்கள் இந்த சாத்தியமான அளவிலான விளைவுகளைப் பார்க்கவும் மதிப்பிடவும் முடியும்.
info.citation:
காஸெர்ட், எஃப்., ஈ. கார்னெஜோ, மற்றும் ஈ. நில்சன். 2021. "காலநிலை தரவை அணுகக்கூடியதாக ஆக்குதல்: நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி மற்றும் எல்.ஓ.சி.ஏ கீழ்மட்ட காலநிலை குறிகாட்டிகளை உற்பத்தி செய்வதற்கான முறைகள்" தொழில்நுட்ப குறிப்பு. வாஷிங்டன், டி.சி: வேர்ல்ட் ரிசோர்சஸ் இன்ஸ்டிடியூட். https://www.wri.org/research/making-climate-data-accessible ஆன்லைனில் கிடைக்கிறது. [www.resourcewatch.org] (https://www.resourcewatch.org/).

சி.எம்.ஐ.பி.க்கு பொறுப்பான உலக காலநிலை ஆராய்ச்சித் திட்டத்தின் ஒருங்கிணைந்த மாடலிங் பணிக் குழுவை நாங்கள் அங்கீகரிக்கிறோம், மேலும் அவற்றின் மாதிரி வெளியீட்டை உற்பத்தி செய்து கிடைக்கச் செய்த காலநிலை மாடலிங் குழுக்களுக்கு நாங்கள் நன்றி தெரிவிக்கிறோம். அமெரிக்க எரிசக்தித் துறையின் காலநிலை மாதிரி நோய் கண்டறிதல் மற்றும் இண்டர்கம்பரிசன் திட்டம் சிஎம்ஐபிக்கான புவி அமைப்பு அறிவியல் போர்ட்டல்களுக்கான உலகளாவிய அமைப்புடன் இணைந்து மென்பொருள் உள்கட்டமைப்பின் ஒருங்கிணைப்பு ஆதரவு மற்றும் மேம்பாட்டை வழங்குகிறது.

பயன்படுத்தப்படும் காலநிலை காட்சிகள் நெக்ஸ்-ஜி.டி.டி.பி தரவுத்தொகுப்பில் இருந்து வந்தன, இது காலநிலை பகுப்பாய்வு குழு மற்றும் நாசா அமேஸ் ஆராய்ச்சி மையத்தால் நாசா எர்த் எக்ஸ்சேஞ்சைப் பயன்படுத்தி தயாரிக்கப்பட்டது, மேலும் காலநிலை உருவகப்படுத்துதலுக்கான நாசா மையத்தால் (என்.சி.சி.எஸ்) விநியோகிக்கப்பட்டது.
info.date_of_content: 1960-1990 இன் அடிப்படைக் காலம் மற்றும் 2000 முதல் 2080 வரையிலான ஒவ்வொரு தசாப்தத்திற்கும் எதிர்பார்க்கப்படும் பெறுமதிகள்

attributes.name: విపరీతమైన అవపాతం రోజుల్లో ఊహించిన మార్పు
attributes.description:
### అవలోకనం  
  
1960-1990 నాటి బేస్ లైన్ కాల వ్యవధితో పోలిస్తే 2000 మరియు 2080 మధ్య పది సంవత్సరాల అంతరాల వద్ద తీవ్రమైన అవపాతం యొక్క వార్షిక సగటు రోజుల్లో మార్పును ఎక్స్ ట్రీమ్ అవపాతం డేస్ డేటాసెట్ లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్ ఇన్ ఎక్స్ ట్రీమ్ అవపాతం డేస్ డేటాసెట్ చూపిస్తుంది. బేస్ లైన్ కాలంతో పోలిస్తే అవపాతం 99వ పర్సంటైల్ అవపాతం కంటే ఎక్కువగా ఉండే రోజుగా విపరీతమైన అవపాతం రోజుగా నిర్వచించబడుతుంది. ప్రతి పది సంవత్సరాల విరామం వద్ద చూపించబడ్డ డేటా 31 సంవత్సరాల సగటుకు ప్రాతినిధ్యం వహిస్తుంది, ఇది సూచించబడ్డ సంవత్సరం చుట్టూ కేంద్రీకృతమై ఉంటుంది. ఉదాహరణకు, 2000 లో విపరీతమైన అవపాత రోజుల సంఖ్య వాస్తవానికి 1985 మరియు 2015 సంవత్సరాల మధ్య తీవ్రమైన అవపాతం రోజుల వార్షిక సంఖ్య యొక్క సగటు. వాతావరణ మార్పులపై ఇంటర్ గవర్నమెంటల్ ప్యానెల్ (ఐపిసిసి యొక్క) ప్రతినిధి ఏకాగ్రత మార్గాలు (ఆర్ సిపి) 8.5 ద్వారా నిర్ణయించబడ్డ భవిష్యత్ గ్రీన్ హౌస్ వాయువు ఉద్గార రేట్లపై అవపాత అంచనాలు ఆధారపడి ఉంటాయి. ఆర్ సిపి 8.5 అనేది 21వ శతాబ్దంలో గ్రీన్ హౌస్ వాయువుల ఉద్గార రేట్లు ఏమాత్రం తగ్గని ఒక ఊహాజనిత దృశ్యం. తీవ్రమైన అవపాతంలో మార్పు అంచనా వేయబడిన దశాబ్దంలో తీవ్రమైన అవపాతం యొక్క వార్షిక సగటు రోజుల మధ్య గుణకార వ్యత్యాసంగా చూపబడింది మరియు బేస్ లైన్ కాల వ్యవధి. 1 కంటే ఎక్కువ విలువలు విపరీతమైన అవపాతం పెరుగుతున్నట్లు సూచిస్తాయి, అయితే ఒకటి కంటే తక్కువ విలువలు సంఖ్య తగ్గుతున్నట్లు సూచిస్తాయి. డేటా 0.25° ప్రాదేశిక రిజల్యూషన్ వద్ద ప్రజంట్ చేయబడుతుంది.
  
గ్లోబల్ గ్రీన్ హౌస్ వాయువుల సాంద్రతలు పెరగడం, మరియు వాతావరణంలోని మార్పుల వల్ల, వ్యవసాయం, మౌలిక సదుపాయాలు, విపత్తు నిర్వహణ మరియు మానవ సంఘర్షణపై ప్రభావం చూపించే గ్రహంతో మన సంబంధాన్ని ప్రాథమికంగా మార్చడానికి సెట్ చేయబడింది. ఈ మార్పులను ఊహించడానికి మరియు స్వీకరించడానికి, ఎక్స్ ట్రీమ్ అవపాతం డేస్ డేటాసెట్ లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ చేంజ్ రాబోయే దశాబ్దాల్లో విపరీతమైన అవపాత నమూనాలు ఎలా మారే అవకాశం ఉందనే దానిపై అంచనాలను అందిస్తుంది. సాధారణంగా, విపరీతమైన అవపాత సంఘటనలు ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా మరింత తరచుగా ఉంటాయని భావిస్తున్నారు. 
  
నేషనల్ ఏరోనాటిక్స్ అండ్ స్పేస్ అడ్మినిస్ట్రేషన్ (నాసా) ఎర్త్ ఎక్స్ఛేంజ్ గ్లోబల్ డైలీ డౌన్ స్కేల్డ్ ప్రొజెక్షన్స్ (నెక్స్-జిడిడిపి) ను ఉపయోగించి విజ్జువాలిటీ మరియు వరల్డ్ రిసోర్సెస్ ఇనిస్టిట్యూట్ ద్వారా ఈ డేటాసెట్ ప్రాసెస్ చేయబడింది. ఎన్ ఈఎక్స్-జిడిడిపి డేటాసెట్ అనేది స్థానిక మరియు ప్రాంతీయ స్థాయిల వద్ద వాతావరణ మార్పు ప్రభావాల యొక్క అధ్యయనాలను నిర్వహించడంలో శాస్త్రీయ సమాజానికి సహాయపడటానికి మరియు వ్యక్తిగత పట్టణాలు, నగరాలు మరియు వాటర్ షెడ్ ల ప్రాదేశిక స్థాయిలో భవిష్యత్తు ప్రపంచ వాతావరణ నమూనాలపై ప్రజా అవగాహనను పెంపొందించడానికి ఉద్దేశించబడింది. ఈ డేటాసెట్ యొక్క మునుపటి వెర్షన్ [పార్టనర్ షిప్ ఫర్ రెజిలియెన్స్ అండ్ ప్రిపేర్డ్ నెస్ (ప్రెప్)]](https://prepdata.org/) ద్వారా ప్రాసెస్ చేయబడింది మరియు ఉత్పత్తి చేయబడింది, ఇది వాతావరణ డేటాకు ప్రాప్యతను మెరుగుపరచడం ద్వారా వాతావరణ మార్పులకు స్థితిస్థాపకతను నిర్మించడానికి పి.ఆర్.ఇ.పి యొక్క మిషన్ కు సహాయపడుతుంది.  
  
#### మెథడాలజీ  
  
ఎక్స్ ట్రీమ్ అవపాతం డేస్ డేటాసెట్ లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ చేంజ్ ఎన్ ఈఎక్స్-జిడిడిపి నుండి అవపాత డేటాతో రూపొందించబడింది. ఎన్ ఈఎక్స్-జిడిడిపి డేటాసెట్ లు గ్లోబల్ సర్క్యులేషన్ మోడల్ (జిసిఎమ్) ప్రయోగాల నుండి తీసుకోబడ్డాయి, ఇవి [ఇంటర్ గవర్నమెంటల్ ప్యానెల్ ఆన్ క్లైమేట్ చేంజ్ (ఐపిసిసి) ఐదవ అసెస్ మెంట్ రిపోర్ట్ (ఎఆర్ 5)] (https://www.ipcc.ch/site/assets/uploads/2018/05/SYR_AR5_FINAL_full_wcover.pdf) కొరకు ఉత్పత్తి చేయబడ్డాయి. కపుల్డ్ మోడల్ ఇంటర్ కంపారిసన్ ప్రాజెక్ట్ ఫేజ్ 5 (సిఎమ్ ఐపి5) గా పిలువబడే ఈ ప్రయోగాల్లో గ్రీన్ హౌస్ వాయువు సాంద్రతల యొక్క వివిధ స్థాయిల కింద శీతోష్ణస్థితిని అనుకరించడానికి రూపొందించిన వాతావరణ నమూనాల నుండి ఫలితాలు ఉన్నాయి.  

సిఎమ్ఐపి5 డేటాలో పెద్ద సంఖ్యలో మోడల్స్ (45), క్లైమేట్ దృష్టాంతాలు (4), సంవత్సరాలు (150+), మరియు వేరియబుల్స్ (20-40) ఉన్నాయి. దాని ముతక రిజల్యూషన్ (1-4°) వద్ద కూడా ఇది బిలియన్ల కొద్దీ పొరలకు దారితీస్తుంది. డౌన్ స్కేలింగ్ ద్వారా, నెక్స్-జిడిడిపి తమకు అవసరమైన డేటాను మాత్రమే సంగ్రహిస్తుంది మరియు [షెఫీల్డ్ ఎట్ అల్. (2006)] (https://journals.ametsoc.org/jcli/article/19/13/3088/30860/Development-ఆఫ్-ఎ-50-ఇయర్-హై-రిజల్యూషన్-గ్లోబల్) డేటాసెట్ ను చారిత్రాత్మక రిఫరెన్స్ గా ఉపయోగించి డేటా యొక్క మొత్తం పరిమాణాన్ని తగ్గిస్తుంది.  

ప్రతి సంవత్సరం వార్షిక సగటు విపరీతమైన అవపాతం రోజులు, వాతావరణ నమూనా మరియు దృష్టాంతం ప్రతి-పిక్సెల్ ప్రాతిపదికన నెక్స్-జిడిడిపి డేటాను ఉపయోగించి లెక్కించబడ్డాయి. ఒక నిర్దిష్ట సంవత్సరానికి రోజువారీ అవపాత విలువలను వెలికితీయడం ద్వారా మరియు బేస్ లైన్ కాలంలో 99వ శాతం అవపాతం కంటే అవపాతం ఎక్కువగా ఉన్న రోజుల సంఖ్యను క్రోడీకరించడం ద్వారా ఇది జరిగింది. వార్షిక సగటు విపరీతమైన అవపాతం రోజులు 1960-1990 బేస్ లైన్ కాల వ్యవధికి 31 సంవత్సరాల సగటులుగా మరియు 2000 నుండి 2080 వరకు ప్రతి దశాబ్దం ప్రారంభంలో తొమ్మిది కాలాలు కేంద్రీకృతమై ఉన్నాయి. అప్పుడు తొమ్మిది అంచనా వేయబడిన దశాబ్దాలలో ప్రతి ఒక్కటి తీవ్రమైన అవపాతంలో అంచనా వేయబడిన మార్పును లెక్కించడానికి బేస్ లైన్ సగటుతో భాగించబడ్డాయి. 1 కంటే ఎక్కువ విలువలు విపరీతమైన అవపాతం పెరుగుతున్నట్లు సూచిస్తాయి, అయితే ఒకటి కంటే తక్కువ విలువలు సంఖ్య తగ్గుతున్నట్లు సూచిస్తాయి.

ప్రతి పది సంవత్సరాల విరామం వద్ద చూపించబడ్డ డేటా 31 సంవత్సరాల సగటుకు ప్రాతినిధ్యం వహిస్తుంది, ఇది సూచించబడ్డ సంవత్సరం చుట్టూ కేంద్రీకృతమై ఉంటుంది. ఉదాహరణకు, 2000 లో విపరీతమైన అవపాతం రోజులు వాస్తవానికి 1985 మరియు 2015 సంవత్సరాల మధ్య వార్షిక విపరీతమైన అవపాత రోజుల సగటు. 31-సంవత్సరాల సగటులు ఎంచుకోబడ్డాయి ఎందుకంటే అవి వార్షిక మరియు దశాబ్ధ వైవిధ్యం యొక్క ప్రభావాలను కనిష్టం చేస్తాయి మరియు దీర్ఘకాలిక వాతావరణ సంకేతాన్ని హైలైట్ చేస్తాయి. ప్రపంచ వాతావరణ సంఘం నుండి దీర్ఘకాలిక మార్గదర్శకత్వంతో సమలేఖనం చేయడానికి బేస్ లైన్ కాలం ఎంచుకోబడింది.
  
### అదనపు సమాచారం  
  
రిసోర్స్ వాచ్ [వార్షిక సగటు ఉష్ణోగ్రతలో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ చేంజ్](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/4ca6826c-718d-457d-b4e2-e9277d7d7ed62c), [వార్షిక సగటు కనిష్ట ఉష్ణోగ్రతలో అంచనా వేయబడ్డ మార్పు](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/3d8e2e82-b33a-4898-90e5-6e4a1d007b82 కొరకు ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్ NEX-GDDP RCP 8.5 డేటాను కూడా చూపిస్తుంది.[https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/c4b12251-2d61-458f-718d-457d-457d-457d-457d-457d-457d-457d-457d-457d-457d-457d-b4e2c కొరకు ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్ NEX-GDDP RCP 8.5 డేటాను కూడా రిసోర్స్ వాచ్ చూపిస్తుంది, [వార్షిక సగటు ఉష్ణోగ్రతలో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/3d8e2e82-b33a-4898-90e5-6e4a1d007b82లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్ హీటింగ్ డిగ్రీ డేస్ లో మార్పు](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/1d2f4eae-10e1-4ఈ6-980c-501b34106de2), [కూలింగ్ డిగ్రీ డేస్ లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ చేంజ్](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/6fa000b5-8d91-46c8-8502-07427bc5eafc), [ఫ్రాస్ట్ ఫ్రీ సీజన్ లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/d3f512c0-fbb0-47d5-9ac9-a452574c8e58), [ఎక్స్ ట్రీమ్ హీట్ డేస్ లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/3941bbba-181b-4800 సంచిత అవపాతంలో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/faf79d2c-5ఈ54-4591-9d70-4bd1029c18e6), మరియు [డ్రై స్పెల్స్ లో ప్రొజెక్టెడ్ ఛేంజ్](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/d0f46576-411d-48a-8df8-d89a3792ccece).

రిసోర్స్ వాచ్ డేటా యొక్క ఒక ఉపసమితిని మాత్రమే చూపుతుంది. ఉద్గారాల సందర్భం RCP 4.5 కొరకు అదనపు డేటా లభ్యం అవుతుంది. ఒరిజినల్ NEX-GDDP డేటాసెట్ మరియు అదనపు సమాచారాన్ని యాక్సెస్ చేసుకోవడానికి, లెర్న్ మోర్ లింక్ చూడండి.
  
### డేటాను విజువలైజ్ చేయడం  
  
రిసోర్స్ వాచ్ లో ప్రదర్శించడానికి ముందు మా టీమ్ ఈ డేటాసెట్ ని రీఫార్మాట్ చేసింది. రిసోర్స్ వాచ్ [Github](https://github.com/resource-వాచ్/డేటా-ప్రీ-ప్రాసెసింగ్/ట్రీ/మాస్టర్/cli_050-059_066-075_nexgddp_and_loca)పై డేటాను ఏవిధంగా ప్రాసెస్ చేసిందనే దానిపై డాక్యుమెంటేషన్ ని చూడండి.  
  
### డిస్ క్లెయిమర్  
  
ఈ వివరణ పేజీ యొక్క సారాంశాలు మూల మెటాడేటా నుండి తీసుకోబడ్డాయి.

info.technical_title: ఎక్స్ ట్రీమ్ అవపాతం డేస్, నాసా ఎర్త్ ఎక్స్ఛేంజ్ గ్లోబల్ డైలీ డౌన్ స్కేల్డ్ ప్రొజెక్షన్స్ (నెక్స్-జిడిడిపి) నుండి ఉద్భవించింది.
info.functions: విపరీతమైన అవపాతం యొక్క వార్షిక సగటు రోజుల్లో అంచనా వేయబడ్డ మార్పు

- కొన్ని జిసిఎమ్ లు హిండ్ కాస్ట్ ల్లో రుతుపవనాలు వంటి ప్రాంతీయ వాతావరణ నమూనాలను పునఃసృష్టించడంలో ఇతరుల కంటే మెరుగ్గా పనిచేస్తాయి. నిర్దిష్ట అనువర్తనాల కొరకు, ప్రాంతీయ పనితీరు ఆధారంగా వ్యక్తిగత నమూనాలను ఎంచుకోవడం సముచితంగా ఉండవచ్చు.

attributes.name: [Archived] Tree Cover Gain
attributes.description:
_**This dataset has been archived, and we will no longer be updating or maintaining it. We recommend using [this dataset](426fe3f0-12de-4adb-b3aa-850eb04f75b4) as a replacement.**_
  
This data set, a collaboration between the GLAD (Global Land Analysis and Discovery) lab at the University of Maryland, Google, the U.S. Geological Survey, and  the National Aeronautics and Space Administration, measures areas of tree cover gain across all global land (except Antarctica and other Arctic islands) at 30 × 30 m resolution, displayed as a 12-year cumulative layer. The data were generated using multispectral satellite imagery from the Landsat 7 thematic mapper plus (ETM+) sensor. Over 600,000 Landsat 7 images were compiled and analyzed using Google Earth Engine, a cloud platform for Earth observation and data analysis. The clear land surface observations (30 × 30 m pixels) in the satellite images were assembled, and a supervised learning algorithm was then applied to identify per pixel tree cover gain. Tree cover gain was defined as the establishment of tree canopy at the Landsat pixel scale in an area that previously had no tree cover. Tree cover gain may indicate a number of potential activities, including natural forest growth or the crop rotation cycle of tree plantations. The tree cover canopy density of the displayed data is >50%. Resource Watch shows only a subset of the data set. For access to the full data set and additional information, see the Learn More link.  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Disclaimer  
  
Excerpts of this description page were taken from the source metadata.

info.name: [Archived] Tree Cover Gain
info.technical_title: Global Forest Change 2000–2016
info.functions: Areas of tree cover gain
info.cautions: In this data set, “tree cover” is defined as all vegetation greater than 5 m in height, and may take the form of natural forests or plantations across a range of canopy densities. “Gain” is defined as the establishment of tree canopy at the Landsat pixel scale in an area that previously had no tree cover. Tree cover gain may indicate a number of potential activities, including natural forest growth or the crop rotation cycle of tree plantations. Due to variation in research methodology and date of content, tree cover, loss, and gain data sets cannot be compared accurately against each other. Accordingly, “net” loss cannot be calculated by subtracting figures for tree cover gain from tree cover loss, and current (post-2000) tree cover cannot be determined by subtracting figures for annual tree cover loss from year 2000 tree cover. The authors evaluated the overall prevalence of false positives (commission errors) in these data at 24%, and the prevalence of false negatives (omission errors) at 26%, though the accuracy varies by biome and thus may be higher or lower in any particular location.

attributes.name: Tree Cover Gain
attributes.description:
### Overview  
  
The Tree Cover Gain dataset measures areas of tree cover gain from 2001 through 2012. Tree cover is defined as all vegetation greater than 5 meters (m) in height and may take the form of natural forests or plantations across a range of canopy densities. Gain is mapped for all areas that did not have tree cover in 2000 and had ≥ 50% cover in 2012. Longer-lived regrowing stands of tree cover that did not begin as non-forest within the study period were not mapped as forest gain. The dataset has a spatial resolution of 1 arc second which is approximately 30 m × 30 m at the equator but [changes with distance](https://www.thoughtco.com/degree-of-latitude-and-longitude-distance-4070616) from the equator.
  
  
Forests provide a wide range of ecosystem services that are [critical to biodiversity richness, climate regulation, carbon storage, and water supplies](https://science.sciencemag.org/content/309/5734/570?ijkey=493d3bb49264119aa5ed9175119f7e221b2093d6&keytype2=tf_ipsecsha). They provide shelter to a variety of wildlife species and supply humans with [essential products including lumber, paper, and firewood]( https://www.fs.fed.us/forestmanagement/products/#:~:text=Forest%20products%20include%20materials%20derived,nuts%2C%20and%20other%20natural%20products). In the global fight against climate change, the forest ecosystem is playing an incredibly important role since it [absorbs and stores large amounts of carbon](https://www.undp.org/content/undp/en/home/blog/2018/Forests-A-natural-solution-to-climate-change-crucial-for-a-sustainable-future.html). Through measuring the gain in tree cover of global forests, this dataset provides decision makers with a consistent basis on which to understand the [causes of tree cover loss](https://science.sciencemag.org/content/342/6160/850). It also helps to quantify other critical environmental issues, such as the economic drivers of [natural forest conversion to more intensive land uses](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1549-0831.1998.tb00691.x) and the effectiveness of [protected areas around the globe](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature02422) to represent species diversity.


  
  
The dataset has been created through a collaboration among the Global Land Analysis & Discovery (GLAD) lab at the University of Maryland (UMD), Google, United States Geological Survey (USGS), and National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) with the aim to provide a spatially and temporally detailed quantification of global forest change. 

  
  
### Methodology  
  
The data was generated using multispectral satellite imagery from three sources: the Landsat 5 thematic mapper, the Landsat 7 thematic mapper plus and the Landsat 8 Operational Land Imager sensors. [Images captured during growing seasons](https://doi.org/10.14358/PERS.70.3.313) were used since they are more appropriate for mapping land cover. More than 1 million satellite images were processed, including over 600,000 Landsat 7 images for the 2000-2012 interval and 400,000 Landsat 5, 7 and 8 images for the 2011-2019 interval. 

  
  
The following steps were taken to pre-process the images:
  
  
1. Pixel values were recalculated if image resolutions were changed.
  
  
2. Images were screened for clouds, shadows and water.
  
  
3. Images were [calibrated and normalized](http://gsp.humboldt.edu/OLM/Courses/GSP_216_Online/lesson4-1/radiometric.html) to make them comparable with one another.

  
  
Land surface observations in the satellite images were assembled with a supervised learning algorithm, which involved [using labeled data to develop a machine learning model](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/problem-framing/cases#what-is-supervised-learning) to identify per pixel tree cover gain. To facilitate processing, each continent was characterized individually: North America, South America, Eurasia, Africa, and Australia using [Google Earth Engine](https://earthengine.google.com/), a cloud platform for earth observation data analysis that combines a public data catalog with a large-scale computational facility capable of handling large volumes of geospatial data. For the full documentation, please click on the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch also shows the [Tree Cover](http://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/027799db-c161-462a-9c20-aeb97b84e06e) and the [Tree Cover Loss](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/5c5e654e-182b-4ab4-8a3c-edff79cc68ea) from the same dataset. 
  
  

Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. Additional data for the reference multispectral imagery from 2000 and the reference multispectral imagery from 2019 is available from the data provider. 
For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.
  
  
### Visualizing the Data  
  
Our team reformatted this dataset before displaying it on Resource Watch. See the documentation on how Resource Watch retrieved the data on [Github](https://github.com/resource-watch/data-pre-processing/tree/master/for_007_rw2_tree_cover_gain).

attributes.name: Tsunamis
attributes.description:
The Global Historical Tsunami Database released by NOAA provides information on over 2,400 tsunamis from 2100 BC to the present in the Atlantic, Indian, and Pacific Oceans; and the Mediterranean and Caribbean Seas. The database includes 2 related files. The first file includes information on the tsunami source such as the date, time, and location of the source event; cause and validity of the source; tsunami magnitude and intensity; maximum water height; total number of fatalities, injuries, houses destroyed, and houses damaged; and total damage estimate (in U.S. dollars). The second related file contains information on the runups (the locations where tsunami waves were observed by eyewitnesses, reconnaissance surveys, tide gauges, and deep-ocean sensors), such as name, location, arrival time, maximum water height, and inundation distance, as well as socioeconomic data (deaths, injuries, damage) for the specific runup location. Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. For access to the full dataset and additional information, see the Learn More link.  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.

info.name: Tsunamis
info.technical_title: NGDC/WDS Global Historical Tsunami Database
info.functions: A record of all known tsunamis and their characteristics.
info.cautions:
Erroneous statistical conclusions can be drawn from the numbers of earthquakes taken from Catalog of Significant Earthquakes, 2150 B.C. to the present. The reporting of large or destructive earthquakes is not homogeneous in space or time, particularly for periods prior to the 1900s. Because this publication mainly lists those earthquakes that have caused death or damage, the number of earthquake reports is dependent on the written history available for a particular region, as well as on the rate of development of population centers and related structures. Therefore, it is misleading to use the numbers of significant earthquakes in that publication to suggest statistically that there has been an increase in worldwide seismic activity since 1900 or for any time period. that "apparent" increase in activity: Instrumental seismology is a young science.   
  
The first calibrated instruments to measure seismic waves traveling through the earth did not appear until the late 1800s. At that time, seismologists became aware of the vast numbers of earthquakes occurring throughout the world, but because of the insensitivity of their instruments they were able to locate only the large magnitude events. The 1960s saw two major advances. First, a network of seismological observatories, the Worldwide Standardized Seismograph Network (WWSSN), was installed by the United States Government, principally to monitor underground nuclear tests. These sensitive instruments could detect and identify earthquakes anywhere in the world from about magnitude 4.5. Second computers became available in the late 1960s. Computers allowed seismologists to leave inaccurate and cumbersome graphical methods of locating earthquakes, and to process the increasing volume of new network data more rapidly than ever before.   
  
Prior to 1962, only hundreds of earthquake epicenters were determined each year by Government and academic institutions, but the number increased to the thousands using computerized location methods. In some special local studies, more than 100,000 earthquakes per year were identified and located. In summary, using the data in Catalog of Significant Earthquakes, 2150 B.C. to the present to suggest that there has been an increase in worldwide earthquake activity is misleading and erroneous. The above observations and reporting factors must also be considered when making statistical studies based on that historical data report.

attributes.name: loc.mcaqf.001a Air Quality: Mexico City Carbon Monoxide (CO) Forecast
Air Quality: Mexico City Carbon Monoxide (CO) Forecast
attributes.description:
### Overview  
  
The Air Quality: Mexico City Carbon Monoxide (CO) Forecast dataset provides weather and air quality forecasts for Mexico City. This dataset represents the forecasted density of Carbon Monoxide in parts per billion (ppb). The forecast offers an hourly estimate on Carbon Monoxide density with a spatial resolution of 1 kilometer (km), encompassing Mexico CIty and its Metropolitan Area (MCMA).

  
  
According to the [U.S. Center for Disease Control (CDC)](https://www.cdc.gov/co/faqs.htm), CO is released when fossil fuels are burned. Common household sources include grills, cars, fireplaces, and gas stoves that aren’t properly ventilated. Major sources of CO to outdoor air include cars, trucks and other fossil-fuel-burning machinery. Breathing air with a high concentration of carbon monoxide reduces oxygen availability in the bloodstream for critical organs like the heart and brain. Symptoms of CO poisoning include headache, dizziness, weakness, upset stomach, vomiting, chest pain, and confusion. As stated by [Mexico City Ministry of the Environment (SEDEMA)](http://www.aire.cdmx.gob.mx/descargas/publicaciones/flippingbook/informe_anual_calidad_aire_2017/mobile/informe_anual_calidad_aire_2017v3.pdf), the CO values in Mexico City have been decreasing over the last years, complying with the levels set by the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and the World Health Organization (WHO). The main source of CO in the MCMA is fossil-fuel-burning related to transport, making this pollutant a good indicator to monitor transport-related emissions in the region. Showcasing the spatial distribution of CO in the MCMA will  provide insight about the way a city can produce information according to its needs while complementing global air quality models.The forecast helps the Mexico CIty government to issue health warnings based on the expected air quality for a given day, like recommending citizens to avoid open-air exercise or to limit their use of fossil fuel vehicles.

  
  
The forecast was generated by SEDEMA with help from the Barcelona Supercomputing Center (BSC). SEDEMA provides a tool for the inhabitants of MCMA to make well-informed decisions about dangerous air pollution activity on a given day. SEDEMA works on five environmental issues: air quality and climate change, land conservation and biodiversity, sustainable urban infrastructure, water supply and quality, and environmental communication and education.  
  
### Methodology  
  
The dataset is comprised of the following models:
  
  
Weather: Estimates the weather conditions of the MCMA using data from global systems. It harnesses the [Weather Research and Forecasting Model-Advanced Research (WRF-ARW)](https://www.mmm.ucar.edu/weather-research-and-forecasting-model), which is a mesoscale numerical weather prediction system designed for both atmospheric research and operational forecasting applications. The model generates  temperature, wind, rainfall and solar radiation, among other weather related indicators..
  
  
Emissions: This model makes use of emission inventories for the MCMA to estimate CO levels on an hourly basis, as well as its geospatial distribution.
  
  
Chemical Transport: This model harnesses the outputs from the weather and emissions models as well as other chemical and physical mechanisms to simulate transformations in the atmosphere and the influence of weather dynamics in these processes. For this purpose, the [Community Multiscale Air Quality Modeling System (CMAQ)](https://www.cmascenter.org/cmaq/) is employed to forecast the behavior of the pollutants in the MCMA.

  
  
For the full documentation, please click on the “Learn more” button.

  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch also shows forecasts for [Air Quality: Mexico City Sulfur Dioxide (SO₂) forecast ](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/59790e64-d95d-43fa-a124-5c7eb1cb4456), [Air Quality: Mexico City Ozone  (O₃)Forecast](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/00d6bae1-e105-4165-8230-ee73a8128538), [Air Quality: Mexico City Nitrogen Dioxide  (NO₂) Forecast](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/918ba6bc-69ed-44fb-9b29-5fb445fdfef6), and [Air Quality: Mexico City Fine Particulate Matter (PM2.5)Forecast](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/7a34b770-83f9-4c6a-acb8-31edcff7241e)

  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. The source also includes the outputs for their weather model as well as the measurements of the Mexico City Weather Monitoring System (SIMAT) using their air quality index. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.
  
  
### Visualizing the Data  
  
Our team reformatted this dataset before displaying it on Resource Watch. See the documentation on how Resource Watch processed the data on [Github](https://github.com/resource-watch/nrt-scripts/tree/master/loc_mcaqf_mexico_city_aq_forecast).  
  
### Disclaimer  
  
Excerpts of this description page were taken from the source metadata.

attributes.name: Accessibility to Cities
attributes.description:
### Overview  
  
Accessibility to cities quantifies the time it takes to travel to the nearest urban center via surface transport as of 2015. The dataset uses data on roads, railways, rivers, water bodies, and foot travel on different land cover types. It also includes information on topographical conditions (slope angle and elevation) and additional time for crossing national borders. The dataset was sourced from a variety of resources that each specialize in a specific mode of land transportation.

  
  
The data was created with the goal of understanding how travel time varies for different urban centers. Urban centers typically have higher concentrations of important resources and infrastructure than rural regions. Improving accessibility to these resources is integral to improving equality around the world. 

  
  
The dataset was created by the Malaria Atlas Project (MAP) with travel time in minutes at a 30 arc second spatial resolution (approximately 1 km at the equator).  
  
### Methodology  
  
Researchers first created a model that calculated the travel time for each pixel (1 km²) on earth. It was based on travel time information on roads, railways, and bodies of water. Additionally, information on land cover types, topographic conditions (slope and elevation), and national borders were included, as they usually affect travel time.  An algorithm was then applied to the model to determine the fastest travel times between destinationsThe road and railway datasets were created by merging Open Street Map (OSM) data with a distance-to-roads product derived from the Google roads database from November 2016 and March 2016. Data on river travel was taken from CIA World Data Bank II vector rivers dataset, lake travel from global surface-water occurrence dataset, and ocean travel from the automatic Identification System (AIS) and Voluntary Observing Ship (VOS) program. Undeveloped land was given a baseline speed of movement (by foot) using the MODIS MCD12Q1 land cover product. The final data was adjusted to account for topographical properties using Global Multi-resolution Terrain Elevation Dataset 2010 (GMTED2010) and a one hour travel penalty was added for any border crossing.

  
  
An urban center is defined as a contiguous area with 1,500 or more inhabitants per km² or a majority of built-up land cover coincident with a population center of at least 50,000 inhabitants. Cities were identified using the above assumption based on the Global Human Settlement Grid of High-Density Land Cover (GHS-HDC) data set and country borders were taken from the UN Global Administrative Units Layer (GAUL). Because cities are typically clusters of many cells rather than individual points, they are effectively treated as polygons when calculating travel time from a given point. The accessibility surface map was generated using the cumulative cost function within Google Earth Engine. The map was validated by testing its travel time calculations between 53,091 points compared to travel time estimates calculated by Google Maps. 

  
  
The final accessibility map was presented in raster format with a spatial resolution of 30 arc seconds (around 1 km at the equator). For the full documentation, please see the source [methodology](https://www.nature.com/articles/nature25181).  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Visualizing the Data  
  
Our team reformatted this dataset before displaying it on Resource Watch.  
  
### Disclaimer  
  
Excerpts of this description page were taken from the source metadata.

info.name: Accessibility to Cities

sources.source-description: European Commission Joint Research Centre (EC JRC)

info.technical_title: Accessibility to Cities 2015
info.functions: Travel time to urban centers via surface transport as of 2015
info.cautions:
- As with most globally modelled data, assumptions, generalizations, and the use of best-available dataset can contribute to errors. These maps were created solely from infrastructure and landscape data. They do not take into account other factors that could play a role in transportation times, likewealth. 
- OSM does not differentiate railroads by type, so all railroads are assigned a relatively slow speed. Due to this, high speed train travel is effectively absent from the map. 
- The map does not take into consideration the transfer time between different modes of transport. This can cause the map to use railroad and water travel more frequently in some cases.
- Slope angle presents a challenge because it is represented as always slowing movement down, regardless of whether the least-cost-path is oriented uphill or downhill. This has led to some unrealistically high travel times,  like in western Colombia. 
- The map also does not take into account geopolitics or disputed borders. 
- Seasonal changes present a major challenge when characterizing accessibility.  This is particularly apparent when they pertain to areas periodically inundated by water or covered by deep snow in which movement may be impossible for parts of the year and/or people may change their mode of transport.

Howes, L.S. Tusting, S.Y. Kang, E. Cameron, D. Bisanzio, K.E. Battle, S. Bhatt, and P.W. Gething. 2018. "A global map of travel time to cities to assess inequalities in accessibility in 2015." attributes.name: Accesibilidad a las ciudades
attributes.description:
### Visión general  
  
La accesibilidad a las ciudades cuantifica el tiempo que se tarda en viajar al centro urbano más cercano a través del transporte de superficie a partir de 2015. El conjunto de datos utiliza datos sobre carreteras, ferrocarriles, ríos, cuerpos de agua y viajes a pie en diferentes tipos de cobertura terrestre. También incluye información sobre las condiciones topográficas (ángulo de pendiente y elevación) y tiempo adicional para cruzar las fronteras nacionales. El conjunto de datos se obtuvo de una variedad de recursos que se especializan en un modo específico de transporte terrestre.

Los datos se crearon con el objetivo de comprender cómo varía el tiempo de viaje para diferentes centros urbanos. Los centros urbanos suelen tener concentraciones más altas de recursos e infraestructura importantes que las regiones rurales. Mejorar la accesibilidad a estos recursos es fundamental para mejorar la igualdad en todo el mundo. 

El conjunto de datos fue creado por el Proyecto Atlas de la Malaria (MAP) con el tiempo de viaje en minutos a una resolución espacial de 30 segundos de arco (aproximadamente 1 km en el ecuador).  
### Metodología  
  
Los investigadores crearon por primera vez un modelo que calculaba el tiempo de viaje para cada píxel (1 km²) en la tierra. Se basó en información sobre el tiempo de viaje en carreteras, ferrocarriles y cuerpos de agua. Además, se incluyó información sobre los tipos de cobertura terrestre, las condiciones topográficas (pendiente y elevación) y las fronteras nacionales, ya que generalmente afectan el tiempo de viaje.  Luego se aplicó un algoritmo al modelo para determinar los tiempos de viaje más rápidos entre destinosLos conjuntos de datos de carreteras y ferrocarriles se crearon fusionando datos de Open Street Map (OSM) con un producto de distancia a las carreteras derivado de la base de datos de carreteras de Google de noviembre de 2016 y marzo de 2016. Los datos sobre los viajes fluviales se tomaron del conjunto de datos de ríos vectoriales II del Banco Mundial de Datos de la CIA, el viaje al lago del conjunto de datos globales de ocurrencia de aguas superficiales y los viajes oceánicos del sistema de identificación automática (AIS) y el programa de buques de observación voluntaria (VOS). A la tierra no desarrollada se le dio una velocidad de movimiento de referencia (a pie) utilizando el producto de cobertura terrestre MODIS MCD12Q1. Los datos finales se ajustaron para tener en cuenta las propiedades topográficas utilizando Global Multi-resolution Terrain Elevation Dataset 2010 (GMTED2010) y se agregó una penalización de viaje de una hora para cualquier cruce fronterizo.

Un centro urbano se define como un área contigua con 1.500 o más habitantes por km² o una mayoría de cobertura de suelo urbanizada coincidente con un centro de población de al menos 50.000 habitantes. Las ciudades se identificaron utilizando el supuesto anterior basado en el conjunto de datos de la Red Mundial de Asentamientos Humanos de Cobertura Terrestre de Alta Densidad (GHS-HDC) y las fronteras de los países se tomaron de la Capa de Unidades Administrativas Globales de las Naciones Unidas (GAUL). Debido a que las ciudades son típicamente grupos de muchas células en lugar de puntos individuales, se tratan efectivamente como polígonos al calcular el tiempo de viaje desde un punto determinado. El mapa de superficie de accesibilidad se generó utilizando la función de costo acumulativo dentro de Google Earth Engine. El mapa fue validado probando sus cálculos de tiempo de viaje entre 53.091 puntos en comparación con las estimaciones de tiempo de viaje calculadas por Google Maps. 

El mapa de accesibilidad final se presentó en formato ráster con una resolución espacial de 30 segundos de arco (alrededor de 1 km en el ecuador). Para obtener la documentación completa, consulte la fuente [metodología](https://www.nature.com/articles/nature25181).  
  
### Información adicional  
  
Resource Watch muestra solo un subconjunto del conjunto de datos. Para acceder al conjunto de datos completo e información adicional, haga clic en el botón "Más información".  
  
### Visualización de los datos  
  
Nuestro equipo reformateó este conjunto de datos antes de mostrarlo en Resource Watch.  
  
### Descargo de responsabilidad  
  
Extractos de esta página de descripción fueron tomados de los metadatos de origen.

info.technical_title: Accesibilidad a las Ciudades 2015
info.functions: Tiempo de viaje a los centros urbanos a través del transporte de superficie a partir de 2015
info.cautions:
- Al igual que con la mayoría de los datos modelados a nivel mundial, las suposiciones, las generalizaciones y el uso del mejor conjunto de datos disponible pueden contribuir a los errores. Estos mapas se crearon únicamente a partir de datos de infraestructura y paisaje. No tienen en cuenta otros factores que podrían desempeñar un papel en los tiempos de transporte, como la riqueza. 
- OSM no diferencia los ferrocarriles por tipo, por lo que a todos los ferrocarriles se les asigna una velocidad relativamente lenta. Debido a esto, los viajes en tren de alta velocidad están efectivamente ausentes del mapa. 
- El mapa no tiene en cuenta el tiempo de transferencia entre diferentes modos de transporte. Esto puede hacer que el mapa use el ferrocarril y el agua con más frecuencia en algunos casos.
- El ángulo de pendiente presenta un desafío porque se representa como siempre ralentizando el movimiento, independientemente de si el camino de menor costo está orientado cuesta arriba o cuesta abajo. Esto ha llevado a algunos tiempos de viaje irrealmente altos, como en el oeste de Colombia. 
- El mapa tampoco tiene en cuenta la geopolítica ni las fronteras en disputa. 
- Los cambios estacionales presentan un gran reto a la hora de caracterizar la accesibilidad.  Esto es particularmente evidente cuando se refieren a áreas periódicamente inundadas por el agua o cubiertas por nieve profunda en las que el movimiento puede ser imposible durante partes del año y / o las personas pueden cambiar su modo de transporte.

attributes.name: நகரங்களுக்கான அணுகல்தன்மை
attributes.description:
### கண்ணோட்டம்  
  
நகரங்களுக்கான அணுகல்தன்மை 2015 ஆம் ஆண்டு நிலவரப்படி மேற்பரப்பு போக்குவரத்து வழியாக அருகிலுள்ள நகர்ப்புற மையத்திற்கு பயணிக்க எடுக்கும் நேரத்தை அளவிடுகிறது. சாலைகள், இருப்புப்பாதைகள், ஆறுகள், நீர்நிலைகள் மற்றும் வெவ்வேறு நிலப்பரப்பு வகைகளில் நடைப்பயணம் பற்றிய தரவுகளை இந்த தரவுத்தொகுப்பு பயன்படுத்துகிறது. இது இடவியல் நிலைமைகள் (சாய்வு கோணம் மற்றும் உயரம்) மற்றும் தேசிய எல்லைகளைக் கடப்பதற்கான கூடுதல் நேரம் பற்றிய தகவல்களையும் உள்ளடக்கியது. தரவுத்தொகுப்பு ஒவ்வொன்றும் ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட நிலப் போக்குவரத்தில் நிபுணத்துவம் பெற்ற பல்வேறு வளங்களிலிருந்து பெறப்பட்டது.

வெவ்வேறு நகர்ப்புற மையங்களுக்கு பயண நேரம் எவ்வாறு வேறுபடுகிறது என்பதைப் புரிந்துகொள்ளும் நோக்கத்துடன் தரவு உருவாக்கப்பட்டது. நகர்ப்புற மையங்கள் பொதுவாக கிராமப்புறங்களை விட முக்கியமான வளங்கள் மற்றும் உள்கட்டமைப்பின் அதிக செறிவுகளைக் கொண்டுள்ளன. இந்த வளங்களை அணுகுவதை மேம்படுத்துவது உலகெங்கிலும் சமத்துவத்தை மேம்படுத்துவதற்கான ஒருங்கிணைந்ததாகும். 

இந்த தரவுத்தொகுப்பு மலேரியா அட்லஸ் திட்டத்தால் (வரைபடம்) 30 வில் இரண்டாவது இடஞ்சார்ந்த தெளிவுத்திறனில் (பூமத்திய ரேகையில் தோராயமாக 1 கி.மீ) நிமிடங்களில் பயண நேரத்தைக் கொண்டு உருவாக்கப்பட்டது.  
### முறைமை  
  
ஆராய்ச்சியாளர்கள் முதலில் பூமியில் உள்ள ஒவ்வொரு பிக்சலுக்கும் (1 கிமீ²) பயண நேரத்தை கணக்கிடும் ஒரு மாதிரியை உருவாக்கினர். இது சாலைகள், இரயில் பாதைகள் மற்றும் நீர்நிலைகள் பற்றிய பயண நேரத் தகவல்களை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டது. கூடுதலாக, நில உறை வகைகள், இடவியல் நிலைமைகள் (சரிவு மற்றும் உயரம்) மற்றும் தேசிய எல்லைகள் பற்றிய தகவல்கள் சேர்க்கப்பட்டன, ஏனெனில் அவை வழக்கமாக பயண நேரத்தை பாதிக்கின்றன.  நவம்பர் 2016 மற்றும் மார்ச் 2016 முதல் கூகிள் சாலைகள் தரவுத்தளத்தில் இருந்து பெறப்பட்ட தூரத்திலிருந்து சாலை தயாரிப்புடன் திறந்த தெரு வரைபடம் (ஓஎஸ்எம்) தரவை இணைப்பதன் மூலம் சாலை மற்றும் ரயில்வே தரவுத்தொகுப்புகள் உருவாக்கப்பட்டன. சிஐஏ உலக தரவு வங்கி இரண்டாம் வெக்டார் ரிவர்ஸ் டேட்டாசெட், உலகளாவிய மேற்பரப்பு-நீர் நிகழ்வு தரவுத்தொகுப்பில் இருந்து ஏரி பயணம் மற்றும் தானியங்கி அடையாள அமைப்பு (ஏஐஎஸ்) மற்றும் தன்னார்வ கண்காணிப்பு கப்பல் (விஓஎஸ்) திட்டத்திலிருந்து கடல் பயணம் ஆகியவற்றிலிருந்து ஆற்றுப் பயணம் பற்றிய தரவுகள் எடுக்கப்பட்டன. வளர்ச்சியடையாத நிலம் மோடிஸ் எம்.சி.டி.12 க்யூ 1 நில கவர் தயாரிப்பைப் பயன்படுத்தி இயக்கத்தின் அடிப்படை வேகம் (கால் மூலம்) வழங்கப்பட்டது. இறுதித் தரவு உலகளாவிய பல தெளிவுத்திறன் கொண்ட நிலப்பரப்பு உயர தரவுத்தொகுப்பு 2010 (ஜிஎம்டிஇடி2010) ஐப் பயன்படுத்தி இடவியல் பண்புகளுக்கு கணக்கிட சரிசெய்யப்பட்டது மற்றும் எந்தவொரு எல்லைக் கடப்பிற்கும் ஒரு மணி நேர பயண அபராதம் சேர்க்கப்பட்டது.

ஒரு நகர்ப்புற மையம் என்பது ஒரு கி.மீ.க்கு 1,500 அல்லது அதற்கு மேற்பட்ட மக்கள் தொகை கொண்ட ஒரு தொடர்ச்சியான பகுதி அல்லது குறைந்தபட்சம் 50,000 மக்கள் தொகை மையத்துடன் இணைந்துள்ள கட்டமைக்கப்பட்ட நிலப்பரப்பின் பெரும்பகுதி என வரையறுக்கப்படுகிறது. உயர் அடர்த்தி நில கவர் (ஜி.எச்.எஸ்-எச்.டி.சி) தரவுத் தொகுப்பின் உலகளாவிய மனித குடியேற்ற கட்டத்தை அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டு மேற்கண்ட அனுமானத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தி நகரங்கள் அடையாளம் காணப்பட்டன, மேலும் நாட்டின் எல்லைகள் ஐ.நா. உலகளாவிய நிர்வாக அலகுகள் அடுக்கிலிருந்து (ஜி.ஏ.எல்) எடுக்கப்பட்டன. நகரங்கள் பொதுவாக தனிப்பட்ட புள்ளிகளை விட பல செல்களின் கொத்துகளாக இருப்பதால், ஒரு குறிப்பிட்ட புள்ளியிலிருந்து பயண நேரத்தை கணக்கிடும்போது அவை பலகோணங்களாக திறம்பட கருதப்படுகின்றன. அணுகல்தன்மை மேற்பரப்பு வரைபடம் கூகிள் எர்த் என்ஜினில் உள்ள ஒட்டுமொத்த செலவு செயல்பாட்டைப் பயன்படுத்தி உருவாக்கப்பட்டது. கூகிள் மேப்ஸால் கணக்கிடப்பட்ட பயண நேர மதிப்பீடுகளுடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது 53,091 புள்ளிகளுக்கு இடையில் அதன் பயண நேர கணக்கீடுகளை சோதிப்பதன் மூலம் வரைபடம் சரிபார்க்கப்பட்டது. 

இறுதி அணுகல் வரைபடம் 30 வில் விநாடிகளின் (பூமத்திய ரேகையில் சுமார் 1 கி.மீ) இடஞ்சார்ந்த தெளிவுத்திறனுடன் ராஸ்டர் வடிவத்தில் வழங்கப்பட்டது. முழு ஆவணப்படுத்தலுக்கு, தயவுசெய்து மூலத்தைப் பார்க்கவும் [method](https://www.nature.com/articles/nature25181).  
  
### கூடுதல் தகவல்  
  
Resource Watch தரவுத்தொகுப்பின் ஒரு துணைக்குழுவை மட்டுமே காட்டுகிறது. முழு தரவுத்தொகுப்பு மற்றும் கூடுதல் தகவலுக்கான அணுகலுக்கு, "மேலும் அறிக" பொத்தானைக் கிளிக் செய்க.  
  
### தரவை காட்சிப்படுத்தல்  
  
Resource Watch இல் காண்பிக்கப்படுவதற்கு முன்பு எங்கள் குழு இந்த தரவுத்தொகுப்பை மறுவடிவமைத்தது.  
  
### பொறுப்புத்துறப்பு  
  
இந்த விளக்கப் பக்கத்தின் பகுதிகள் மூல மெட்டாடேட்டாவிலிருந்து எடுக்கப்பட்டன.

info.cautions:
- மிகவும் உலகளாவிய மாதிரி தரவு, அனுமானங்கள், பொதுமைப்படுத்தல்கள் மற்றும் சிறந்த கிடைக்கக்கூடிய தரவுத்தொகுப்பின் பயன்பாடு ஆகியவை பிழைகளுக்கு பங்களிக்கக்கூடும். இந்த வரைபடங்கள் உள்கட்டமைப்பு மற்றும் நிலப்பரப்புத் தரவுகளிலிருந்து மட்டுமே உருவாக்கப்பட்டன. செல்வவளம் போன்ற போக்குவரத்து நேரங்களில் ஒரு பாத்திரத்தை வகிக்கக்கூடிய பிற காரணிகளை அவர்கள் கணக்கில் எடுத்துக்கொள்வதில்லை. 
- ஓ.எஸ்.எம் ரயில் பாதைகளை வகையால் வேறுபடுத்துவதில்லை, எனவே அனைத்து ரயில் பாதைகளும் ஒப்பீட்டளவில் மெதுவான வேகத்தை ஒதுக்குகின்றன. இதன் காரணமாக, அதிவேக ரயில் பயணம் வரைபடத்தில் திறம்பட இல்லை. 
- பல்வேறு போக்குவரத்து முறைகளுக்கு இடையிலான பரிமாற்ற நேரத்தை வரைபடம் கணக்கில் எடுத்துக்கொள்வதில்லை. இது வரைபடம் சில சந்தர்ப்பங்களில் இரயில் பாதை மற்றும் நீர் பயணத்தை அடிக்கடி பயன்படுத்தக்கூடும்.
- சாய்வு கோணம் ஒரு சவாலை முன்வைக்கிறது, ஏனெனில் இது எப்போதும் இயக்கத்தை மெதுவாக்குவதாக குறிப்பிடப்படுகிறது, குறைந்த செலவு-பாதை மேல்நோக்கி அல்லது கீழ்நோக்கியதா என்பதைப் பொருட்படுத்தாமல். இது மேற்கு கொலம்பியாவைப் போலவே, சில நம்பத்தகாத உயர் பயண நேரங்களுக்கு வழிவகுத்தது. 
- இந்த வரைபடம் புவிசார் அரசியல் அல்லது சர்ச்சைக்குரிய எல்லைகளையும் கணக்கில் எடுத்துக்கொள்வதில்லை. 
- பருவகால மாற்றங்கள் அணுகல்தன்மையை வகைப்படுத்தும் போது ஒரு பெரிய சவாலை முன்வைக்கின்றன.  வருடத்தின் சில பகுதிகளுக்கு இயக்கம் சாத்தியமற்றதாக இருக்கலாம் மற்றும் / அல்லது மக்கள் தங்கள் போக்குவரத்து முறையை மாற்றக்கூடிய ஆழமான பனியால் அவ்வப்போது மூழ்கடிக்கப்படும் அல்லது ஆழமான பனியால் மூடப்பட்டிருக்கும் பகுதிகள் தொடர்பான இது குறிப்பாக வெளிப்படையானது.

attributes.name: నగరాలకు ప్రాప్యత
attributes.description:
### అవలోకనం  
  
నగరాలకు ప్రాప్యత ౨౦౧౫ నాటికి ఉపరితల రవాణా ద్వారా సమీప పట్టణ కేంద్రానికి ప్రయాణించడానికి పట్టే సమయాన్ని లెక్కిస్తుంది. ఈ డేటాసెట్ రోడ్లు, రైల్వేలు, నదులు, జలాశయాలు మరియు వివిధ భూ కవర్ రకాలపై పాద ప్రయాణానికి సంబంధించిన డేటాను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది. ఇది టోపోగ్రాఫికల్ పరిస్థితులు (వాలు కోణం మరియు ఎలివేషన్) మరియు జాతీయ సరిహద్దులను దాటడానికి అదనపు సమయంపై సమాచారాన్ని కూడా కలిగి ఉంటుంది. డేటాసెట్ వివిధ రకాల వనరుల నుండి సేకరించబడింది, ప్రతి ఒక్కటి భూమి రవాణా యొక్క ఒక నిర్దిష్ట విధానంలో ప్రత్యేకత కలిగి ఉంటాయి.

వివిధ పట్టణ కేంద్రాలకు ప్రయాణ సమయం ఎలా మారుతుందో అర్థం చేసుకునే లక్ష్యంతో డేటా రూపొందించబడింది. పట్టణ కేంద్రాలు సాధారణంగా గ్రామీణ ప్రాంతాల కంటే ముఖ్యమైన వనరులు మరియు మౌలిక సదుపాయాల యొక్క అధిక సాంద్రతలను కలిగి ఉంటాయి. ఈ వనరులకు ప్రాప్యతను మెరుగుపరచడం అనేది ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా సమానత్వాన్ని మెరుగుపరచడంలో అంతర్భాగం. 

30 ఆర్క్ సెకండ్ స్పేషియల్ రిజల్యూషన్ (భూమధ్యరేఖ వద్ద సుమారు 1 కి.మీ) వద్ద ప్రయాణ సమయం నిమిషాలలో ప్రయాణించడానికి పట్టే సమయంతో మలేరియా అట్లాస్ ప్రాజెక్ట్ (మ్యాప్) ద్వారా డేటాసెట్ రూపొందించబడింది.  
#### మెథడాలజీ  
  
పరిశోధకులు మొదట ఒక నమూనాను రూపొందించారు, ఇది భూమిపై ప్రతి పిక్సెల్ (1 చ.కి.మీ) ప్రయాణ సమయాన్ని లెక్కించింది. ఇది రోడ్లు, రైల్వేలు మరియు నీటి వనరులపై ప్రయాణ సమయ సమాచారంపై ఆధారపడి ఉంది. అదనంగా, ల్యాండ్ కవర్ రకాలు, టోపోగ్రాఫిక్ పరిస్థితులు (వాలు మరియు ఎలివేషన్), మరియు జాతీయ సరిహద్దులపై సమాచారం చేర్చబడింది, ఎందుకంటే అవి సాధారణంగా ప్రయాణ సమయాన్ని ప్రభావితం చేస్తాయి.  గమ్యస్థానాల మధ్య వేగవంతమైన ప్రయాణ సమయాలను నిర్ణయించడానికి ఒక అల్గోరిథం తరువాత నమూనాకు వర్తింపజేయబడింది రహదారి మరియు రైల్వే డేటాసెట్లు నవంబర్ 2016 మరియు మార్చి 2016 నుండి గూగుల్ రోడ్స్ డేటాబేస్ నుండి సేకరించిన దూర-నుండి-రోడ్స్ ఉత్పత్తితో ఓపెన్ స్ట్రీట్ మ్యాప్ (OSM) డేటాను విలీనం చేయడం ద్వారా రూపొందించబడ్డాయి. సిఐఎ వరల్డ్ డేటా బ్యాంక్ 2 వెక్టర్ రివర్స్ డేటాసెట్, గ్లోబల్ సర్ఫేస్ వాటర్ కాన్సిడెన్స్ డేటాసెట్ నుండి లేక్ ట్రావెల్, మరియు ఆటోమేటిక్ ఐడెంటిఫికేషన్ సిస్టమ్ (ఎఐఎస్) మరియు వాలంటరీ అబ్జర్వేషన్ షిప్ (వివోఎస్) ప్రోగ్రామ్ నుండి సముద్ర ప్రయాణం నుండి నదీ ప్రయాణానికి సంబంధించిన డేటా తీసుకోబడింది. అభివృద్ధి చెందని భూమికి మోడిఎస్ ఎమ్ సిడి12 క్యూ1 ల్యాండ్ కవర్ ప్రొడక్ట్ ఉపయోగించి బేస్ లైన్ స్పీడ్ మూవ్ మెంట్ (కాలి ద్వారా) ఇవ్వబడింది. గ్లోబల్ మల్టీ రిజల్యూషన్ టెర్రైన్ ఎలివేషన్ డేటాసెట్ 2010 (జిఎమ్ టిఇడి2010) ఉపయోగించి టోపోగ్రాఫికల్ ప్రాపర్టీస్ కొరకు తుది డేటా సర్దుబాటు చేయబడింది మరియు ఏదైనా బోర్డర్ క్రాసింగ్ కొరకు ఒక గంట ట్రావెల్ పెనాల్టీ జోడించబడింది.

ఒక పట్టణ కేంద్రాన్ని చదరపు చ.కి.మీ.కు 1,500 లేదా అంతకంటే ఎక్కువ మంది నివాసితులు లేదా కనీసం 50,000 మంది నివసించే జనాభా కేంద్రంతో ఏకీభవించిన అధిక భాగం నిర్మితమైన భూమితో కూడిన సమీప ప్రాంతంగా నిర్వచించబడింది. గ్లోబల్ హ్యూమన్ సెటిల్మెంట్ గ్రిడ్ ఆఫ్ హై-డెన్సిటీ ల్యాండ్ కవర్ (జిహెచ్ఎస్-హెచ్డిసి) డేటా సెట్ ఆధారంగా పై ఊహను ఉపయోగించి నగరాలు గుర్తించబడ్డాయి మరియు ఐక్యరాజ్యసమితి గ్లోబల్ అడ్మినిస్ట్రేటివ్ యూనిట్స్ లేయర్ (జిఎయుఎల్) నుండి దేశ సరిహద్దులు తీసుకోబడ్డాయి. నగరాలు సాధారణంగా వ్యక్తిగత బిందువుల కంటే అనేక కణాల సమూహాలుగా ఉంటాయి కాబట్టి, ఒక నిర్దిష్ట బిందువు నుండి ప్రయాణ సమయాన్ని లెక్కించేటప్పుడు అవి బహుభుజిగా సమర్థవంతంగా పరిగణించబడతాయి. గూగుల్ ఎర్త్ ఇంజిన్ లోపల క్యుమిలేటివ్ కాస్ట్ ఫంక్షన్ ఉపయోగించి యాక్సెసబిలిటీ సర్ఫేస్ మ్యాప్ జనరేట్ చేయబడింది. గూగుల్ మ్యాప్స్ లెక్కించిన ట్రావెల్ టైమ్ ఎస్టిమేట్లతో పోలిస్తే 53,091 పాయింట్ల మధ్య ట్రావెల్ టైమ్ కాలిక్యులేషన్స్ను పరీక్షించడం ద్వారా మ్యాప్ను ధృవీకరించారు. 

తుది యాక్సెసబిలిటీ మ్యాప్ ను 30 ఆర్క్ సెకన్ల ప్రాదేశిక రిజల్యూషన్ తో (భూమధ్యరేఖ వద్ద సుమారు 1 కి.మీ) రాస్టర్ ఫార్మాట్ లో సమర్పించారు. పూర్తి డాక్యుమెంటేషన్ కొరకు, దయచేసి సోర్స్ [మెథడాలజీ](https://www.nature.com/articles/nature25181) చూడండి.  
  
### అదనపు సమాచారం  
  
రిసోర్స్ వాచ్ డేటాసెట్ యొక్క ఉపసమితిని మాత్రమే చూపుతుంది. పూర్తి డేటాసెట్ మరియు అదనపు సమాచారాన్ని యాక్సెస్ చేసుకోవడానికి, "మరింత తెలుసుకోండి" బటన్ మీద క్లిక్ చేయండి.  
  
### డేటాను విజువలైజ్ చేయడం  
  
రిసోర్స్ వాచ్ లో ప్రదర్శించడానికి ముందు మా టీమ్ ఈ డేటాసెట్ ని రీఫార్మాట్ చేసింది.  
  
### డిస్ క్లెయిమర్  
  
ఈ వివరణ పేజీ యొక్క సారాంశాలు మూల మెటాడేటా నుండి తీసుకోబడ్డాయి.

info.technical_title: నగరాలకు ప్రాప్యత 2015
info.functions: 2015 నాటికి ఉపరితల రవాణా ద్వారా పట్టణ కేంద్రాలకు ప్రయాణ సమయం
info.cautions:
- చాలా ప్రపంచవ్యాప్తంగా మోడలింగ్ డేటా వలె, అంచనాలు, సాధారణీకరణలు మరియు ఉత్తమంగా అందుబాటులో ఉన్న డేటాసెట్ యొక్క ఉపయోగం దోషాలకు దోహదం చేస్తాయి. ఈ పటాలు మౌలిక సదుపాయాలు మరియు ల్యాండ్ స్కేప్ డేటా నుండి మాత్రమే రూపొందించబడ్డాయి. రవాణా సమయాల్లో పాత్ర పోషించే ఇతర కారకాలను వారు పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోరు, వెల్త్ వంటిది. 
- OSM రైలుమార్గాలను రకాన్ని బట్టి వేరు చేయదు, కాబట్టి అన్ని రైలు మార్గాలు సాపేక్షంగా నెమ్మదిగా వేగాన్ని కేటాయిస్తాయి. ఈ కారణంగా, హైస్పీడ్ రైలు ప్రయాణం మ్యాప్ నుండి సమర్థవంతంగా లోపిస్తుంది. 
- వివిధ రవాణా విధానాల మధ్య బదిలీ సమయాన్ని మ్యాప్ పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోదు. ఇది మ్యాప్ రైలు మార్గాన్ని ఉపయోగించడానికి మరియు కొన్ని సందర్భాల్లో నీటి ప్రయాణాన్ని మరింత తరచుగా ఉపయోగించడానికి కారణమవుతుంది.
- వాలు కోణం ఒక సవాలును అందిస్తుంది, ఎందుకంటే ఇది ఎల్లప్పుడూ కదలికను నెమ్మదిస్తుంది, తక్కువ ఖర్చు-మార్గం పైకి లేదా దిగువకు కేంద్రీకృతమై ఉందా అనే దానితో సంబంధం లేకుండా. ఇది పశ్చిమ కొలంబియాలో వలె కొన్ని అవాస్తవికంగా అధిక ప్రయాణ సమయాలకు దారితీసింది.

- ప్రాప్యతను వర్గీకరించేటప్పుడు కాలానుగుణ మార్పులు ప్రధాన సవాలుగా ఉంటాయి.  అవి నియతానుసారంగా నీటితో ముంపునకు గురయ్యే లేదా లోతైన మంచుతో కప్పబడిన ప్రాంతాలకు సంబంధించి ఇది ప్రత్యేకంగా స్పష్టమవుతుంది, దీనిలో సంవత్సరంలోని కొన్ని భాగాలకు చలనం అసాధ్యం మరియు/లేదా ప్రజలు తమ రవాణా విధానాన్ని మార్చుకోవచ్చు.

attributes.name: Volcano Eruptions
attributes.description:
### Overview  
  
The Volcano Eruptions dataset shows the location of currently active and historically active volcanoes since the Holocene Epoch. The Holocene Epoch is a geological time period that began over 10,000 years ago. 
  
  
This dataset was created as a way of better understanding Earth's active volcanoes and their eruptions. Volcanoes were a key component in forming the landscapes we see today and in the present time they can have serious impacts for people living in close proximity to them. Understanding active volcanoes, their trends, and how to predict them serves as a way of protecting people and understanding how the Earth was formed.
  
  
The data is taken from the Volcanoes of the World database, which is part of the Global Volcanism Program (GVP) run by the Smithsonian Institution. The mission of GVP is to document, understand, and disseminate information about global volcanic activity.
  
  
### Methodology  
  
The Volcanoes of the World database was created and is continually updated by GVP with information from organizations around the world. During the early stages of an eruption anywhere in the world GVP acts as a clearinghouse of reports, data, and imagery. After GVP staff verifies the information, it is added to the Volcanoes of the World database. The database is made available to the public and updated approximately every 1-3 months.
  
  
For the full documentation, please click on the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch also shows a [volcanic activity report](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/dis003-Weekly-Volcano-Report-NEW) dataset on weekly eruptions that is produced by the same data provider. 

  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. Additional data for active eruptions including eruption type, maximum Volcanic Explosivity Index (VEI), start and end dates (when known), and the type of evidence is available in the Volcanoes of the World database. Also, a list of volcanoes thought to have been active during the Pleistocene Epoch is available from the data provider. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Visualizing the Data  
  
Our team reformatted this dataset before displaying it on Resource Watch. See the documentation on how Resource Watch processed the data on [Github](https://github.com/resource-watch/nrt-scripts/tree/master/dis_013_volcano_eruptions). Coordinates provided in the source data were used to map this data for display on Resource Watch.  
  
### Disclaimer

attributes.name: [Archived] Environmental Performance Index
attributes.description:
_**This dataset has been archived, and we will no longer be updating or maintaining it. We recommend using [this dataset](faaf0a0f-7475-49f3-bb8b-68edfaad4b77) as a replacement.**_
  
The Environmental Performance Index (EPI), produced by the Yale Center for Environmental Law and Policy (YCELP), Data-Driven Yale, and the Columbia University Earth Institute Center for International Earth Science Information Network (CEISIN), scores countries from 0 to 100 according to each country's relative performance on a set of environmental indicators. A score of 100 means that the country ranks above a high-quality benchmark for all its indicators. A score of 0 means that the country ranks below some low-quality benchmark for all its indicators. The index is built from 19 national-level indicators relevant to environmental issues, grouped into 9 issues, which are themselves divided into 2 overarching themes: (1) ecosystem vitality and (2) environmental health as it applies to human health. Multiple other data sets were employed to provide context before whittling down to those 19. Each country's score for each indicator is scaled between 0 and 100 to reflect the proximity of its score in that indicator to a high-quality benchmark. The high-quality benchmark can either be a statistical measure—such as the 95th percentile of the distribution of all countries' scores—or a scientifically determined target, such as the World Health Organization's designation of safe and dangerous amounts of particulate matter 2.5 (PM2.5) in the air we breathe. The 19 indicators, each scored been 0 and 100, are then combined with each other to produce the overall EPI score for a country. The indicators are weighted differently depending on the relative reliability of the data that underpin them. A "materiality threshold" is used to determine whether an indicator should count toward a given country's score. Landlocked countries, for example, are not rated according to their marine protected areas or the health of their fisheries. When these indicators are removed, the remaining indicators receive proportionally higher weights in calculating the country total EPI. The EPI uses both primary and secondary data. Primary data come from human-administered surveys or technological monitoring schemes, including data derived from satellites. Secondary data include country-collected statistics, but only when those statistics are submitted to an independent international organization that enforces data reporting and quality requirements. Modeled data are also included. The 2016 global data set is retrieved from the Global Metrics for the Environment—2016 Environmental Performance Index Report. Resource Watch shows only a subset of the data set. For access to the full data set and additional information, see the Learn More link.  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Disclaimer  
  
Excerpts of this description page were taken from the source metadata.

attributes.name: Oil Palm Concessions
attributes.description:
### Overview  
  
The Oil Palm Concessions dataset shows public lands allocated by governments to private companies for industrial-scale oil palm plantations. The dataset is a compilation of concession data from Cameroon, Indonesia, Liberia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, Republic of the Congo and the Solomon Islands. Concession name, company and area in hectares (ha) are included in the Oil Palm Concessions dataset. Oil Palm Concessions data is typically from government agencies or nonprofits, although the data source and date vary by country. The Oil Palm Concessions dataset is updated monthly. 

  
  
Palm oil is an edible vegetable oil produced from the fruits of the oil palm tree. According to the [World Wildlife Fund (WWF)](https://www.worldwildlife.org/industries/palm-oil), oil palm is a highly productive crop and grows only in tropical regions. Palm oil does not require refrigeration and is used in food products, cosmetics and detergents. However, oil palm farming contributes to deforestation and the release of harmful greenhouse gases into the atmosphere. [According to a study from the European Commission](http://pure.iiasa.ac.at/id/eprint/14868/), oil palm farming is responsible for 8% of global agriculture-related deforestation. Deforestation from oil palm farming is most prevalent in Indonesia, Brazil and Malaysia. Deforestation has many harmful impacts on the environment, including habitat destruction, erosion, air pollution and groundwater contamination. Understanding the locations and extent of oil palm plantations provides information about potential environmental impacts. It can also be used to encourage farmers and businesses to use sustainable farming practices. 

  
  
The Oil Palm Concessions dataset was generated by [Global Forest Watch (GFW)](https://www.globalforestwatch.org/about/), an organization established in 1997 by the [World Resources Institute](https://www.wri.org/). WRI is an independent, non-governmental global research organization which seeks to create equity and prosperity through sustainable natural resource management. They provide data and research about climate, energy, food, forests, water, cities and oceans. GFW uses satellite data and cloud computing to monitor deforestation in near real-time. This information is critical to ending illegal deforestation and fires, and promoting sustainable practices. It can be used by business owners and the public to monitor the environmental impacts of activities like logging, mining and farming. Additionally, farmers and landowners can use this data to protect their land and resources.  
  
### Methodology  
  
The term “oil palm concession” refers to an area allocated by a government to a company for industrial-scale oil palm plantations. GFW generated the Oil Palm Concessions dataset by compiling concession data from Cameroon, Indonesia, Liberia, Malaysia, Papua New Guinea, Republic of the Congo and Solomon Islands. Most locations in the dataset include the company, concession name and concession area (ha). 

  
  
Data for each country was collected from various sources, including from government agencies and public documents. The most common source was maps from forestry or agriculture-specific government agencies. Data from the public domain (company websites, news reports, NGOs) was used for countries where data was not readily available from government agencies. This data was used to create polygons representing the locations and boundaries of concessions. Additional information such as company and concession name was added to the polygons as attributes. The Oil Palm Concessions dataset was published in 2019, though the exact dates vary by country. Concession data for each country is available on the [GFW Open Data Portal](https://data.globalforestwatch.org/search?q=oilpalm). 

  
  
For the full documentation, please click on the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click the “Learn more” button.  
  
### Visualizing the Data  
  
Our team reformatted this dataset before displaying it on Resource Watch.  
  
### Disclaimer  
  
Excerpts of this description page were taken from the source metadata.

attributes.name: cit.035b.nrt Air Quality - Satellite Measurements - TROPOMI (CO)
Air Quality: Carbon Monoxide (CO) Satellite Measurements
attributes.description:
### Overview  
  
The Air Quality: CO Satellite Measurements dataset provides global monthly averages of carbon monoxide (CO) densities in the total atmospheric column. Each value shown in the dataset represents the density of CO found between Earth’s surface and the top of the atmosphere. The CO density is reported with units of moles of CO per square meter of air (mol/m²).

  
  
Carbon monoxide (CO) is a colorless, odorless gas that can be harmful when inhaled in large amounts. CO is released during combustion, so the largest outdoor sources of CO are cars, trucks and other vehicles, and machinery that burn fossil fuels. Breathing air with a high concentration of CO reduces the amount of oxygen that can be transported in the bloodstream to critical organs like the heart and brain. At very high levels, which are possible indoors or in other enclosed environments, CO can cause dizziness, confusion, unconsciousness, and death. Very high levels of CO are not likely to occur outdoors. However, when CO levels are elevated outdoors it can be of particular concern to people with preexisting heart disease. These people already have a reduced ability for getting oxygenated blood to their heart. They are especially vulnerable to the effects of CO when exercising or under increased stress. In these situations, short-term exposure to elevated CO may result in reduced oxygen to the heart accompanied by chest pain also known as angina.

  
  
The dataset is made up of data collected from the Sentinel-5 Precursor (S5p) mission, a low Earth orbit polar satellite system.The S5p mission is part of the Global Monitoring of the Environment and Security (GMES/COPERNICUS) space component program headed by the European Commission (EC) in partnership with the European Space Agency (ESA). Its goal is to  provide information and services on air quality, climate, and the ozone layer. The S5p mission includes the TROPOspheric Monitoring Instrument (TROPOMI), which takes daily global observations of key atmospheric components, such as CO, at a 5.5 x 3.5 kilometer (km) resolution.

  
  
Resource Watch also shows TROPOMI data for [nitrogen dioxide (NO₂)](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/Air-Quality-Measurements-TROPOMI-NO),  [ozone (O₃)] (https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/Air-Quality-Measurements-TROPOMI-O), and [absorbing aerosol index (AAI)] (https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/Air-Quality-Measurements-TROPOMI-AER-AI).   
  
### Methodology  
  
The TROPOMI CO dataset was created with data collected by the S5P satellite mission. CO data was collected by determining the amount of sunlight reflected by the troposphere in the 2.3 µm spectral range of the solar spectrum. A spectral range is the range of light wavelengths that a specific spectrometer can measure and in this case it refers to the wavelength of light that CO molecules produce in the atmosphere. The CO data collected using this method was then input into the Shortwave Infrared CO Re- trieval (SICOR) algorithm created by the Netherlands Institute for Space Research. Along with CO data, the following information was input into SICOR:

  
  
- Relative profile of CO and water in the atmosphere for a given region
  
  
- Solar/viewing geometry and geo-location of the S5P satellite
  
  
- Temperature, water vapor/pressure profiles, and geo-potential height of the S5P satellite
  
  
- Estimate of methane (CH₄) abundance as calculated by the TM5-MP global chemistry transport model

  
  
CH₄ estimates were required as CH₄ is used to help filter out the presence of clouds in the model. The algorithm further takes into consideration cloud cover by changing the column sensitivity (altering the minimal amount of light reflection within the column required to determine CO density) according to the light path created by cloud cover. The final results produced by the algorithm were tropospheric vertical column density of CO and the average CO density for the entire vertical column.

  
  
The dataset shown on Resource Watch was mapped by the Google Earth Engine team using the [harpconvert] (https://cdn.rawgit.com/stcorp/harp/master/doc/html/harpconvert.html) tool. For more information on this conversion please see the Google Earth Engine documentation. The offline version of this data is displayed on Resource Watch, which is more complete than its near real-time counterpart, but is released on a greater delay due to the additional processing time needed. For the full documentation, please see the [source methodology](https://sentinel.esa.int/web/sentinel/technical-guides/sentinel-5p/products-algorithms) associated with the “Carbon Monoxide (CO) Total Column”.
  
  
### Additional Information  
  
Resource Watch also shows TROPOMI data for [nitrogen dioxide (NO₂)](https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/Air-Quality-Measurements-TROPOMI-NO),  [ozone (O₃)] (https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/Air-Quality-Measurements-TROPOMI-O), and [absorbing aerosol index (AAI)] (https://resourcewatch.org/data/explore/Air-Quality-Measurements-TROPOMI-AER-AI).
  
  
Resource Watch shows only a subset of the dataset. Additional data for formaldehyde (CH₂O), sulphur dioxide (SO₂), methane (CH₄) and clouds are available from the data provider. Both a near real-time and an offline version of each of these compounds are available. Please see the [Google Earth Engine data catalog](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/tags/tropomi) to access this data. For access to the full dataset and additional information, click on the “Learn more” button.
  
  
### Visualizing the Data  
  
Our team reformatted this dataset before displaying it on Resource Watch. See the documentation on how Resource Watch processed the data on [Github](https://github.com/resource-watch/nrt-scripts/tree/master/cit_035_tropomi_atmospheric_chemistry_model).  
  
### Disclaimer

info.name: Air Quality: Carbon Monoxide (CO) Satellite Measurements
info.technical_title: Sentinel 5 Precursor Tropospheric Monitoring Instrument (S5P/TROPOMI) Offline (OFFL) Level 3 (L3) Carbon Monoxide (CO)
info.functions: Average monthly density of carbon monoxide (CO) in the total atmospheric column
info.cautions:
- The SICOR algorithm calculates vertical CO column density over land and above clouds for ocean regions. Over the ocean surface albedo is too low to retrieve CO. This may cause slight variances between data presented for the troposphere above land and oceans.

  
  
- Some CO data collected by S5P has shown “stripes” (less than 5% of data) where there is a large variability in CO densities. This is likely due to a calibration error of TROPOMI.

  
  
- Validation results found good agreement of TROPOMI CO calculations versus on the ground measurements. The average difference between the TROPOMI CO and reference data over the entire ground-based networks is around 6%. The mean relative difference may exceed 10% at stations with few co-locations. This falls well within the mission requirements (bias at most 15%).
